breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet conditions on all four edges and periodic conditions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omitted the periodic condition and only listed the Dirichlet conditions, thus fixing the inconsistency.
